body:
Fixes sixteen content defects reported during the SKILL.md split sweep (#2918–#2927). They are text errors that no structural guard can see: a wrong count, a stale step name, a dead model pin, a template missing the args its own skill tells you to set. Each was checked against its source of truth (the script, the schema, the CLI, or the other skill), not by reading alone. Per the brief, these need no new guard.

| # | Skill | Fix | Checked against |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | testing `test-analyze` | "Zen" → PAL; dropped the `gemini-2.5-pro` pin | PAL `tools/planner.py`: `requires_model()` is False ("makes no model call") |
| 2 | tools `justfile-expert` | `--dump --dump-format json` relabelled as the whole parsed justfile; added `just --summary` | just 1.58.0 output keys: aliases, assignments, modules, recipes, settings, … |
| 3 | blueprint `work-order` template | removed stray `name:` above `---` | — |
| 4 | blueprint `story-audit` | "six sections" → seven | REFERENCE.md template headings 1–7 |
| 5 | blueprint `feature-tracker-sync` | "Step 3b" → Step 0 (`status_inferred`) | `references/sync-core.md`: Step 0 script owns inference |
| 6 | blueprint `upgrade` | Step 1 now points at the Step 2 snippet; canonical `manifest.json` checked first | `scripts/get-validation-config.sh`, `blueprint-migration` |
| 7 | blueprint `init` / `status` | v3.3.0 / v3.0.0 → v3.4.0 | `scripts/check-blueprint-upgrade-target.sh` |
| 8 | code-quality `code-docs-quality` | removed `name: docs-quality-check` from rule + PRD templates; PRD template matches the schema | migration #423 inserted it; `blueprint-plugin/schemas/prd.schema.json` |
| 9 | code-quality `dry-consolidation` | added `Bash(ty *)`, `Bash(ruff *)`, `Bash(npm test *)` | Step 7 / references commands |
| 10 | session `session-distill` | REFERENCE.md table → link to `references/routing.md` | — |
| 11 | session `session-end` | GH_READY paragraph → pointer to REFERENCE.md; "three" → five passes | AM11 in `test-session-survey.sh` reads SKILL+REFERENCE |
| 12 | git `release-please-protection` | chezmoi location → git-plugin | — |
| 13 | taskwarrior `task-add` | dedup row gains `project:` | Step 3 |
| 14 | github-actions `claude-code-github-workflows` | all 7 templates carry `--model opus --effort medium` | `.claude/rules/workflow-model-effort.md` effort-by-job-shape; YAML parsed |
| 15 | container `container-development` | Skaffold block moved out of the OCI section | pre-split body had it there too |
| 16 | `test-session-survey.sh` | AM11 comment no longer names the splitter's trigger | #2923, #2937 |

Gates: `./scripts/plugin-compliance-check.sh` (0 ❌; the only warnings on touched skills, release-please-protection's description length and session-end's size, were already there), `bash scripts/check-unused-bash-grant.sh --strict` (STATUS=OK, 0 issues), `bash scripts/check-blueprint-upgrade-target.sh` (OK, v3.4.0), `test-session-survey.sh` (693/0), `test-blueprint-feature-tracker-sync.sh` and `test-dry-consolidation.sh` (all pass). No touched SKILL.md crosses 10,000 chars; story-audit (9,996) and test-analyze (9,996) were trimmed to stay under, and session-end drops from 11,341 to 11,013.
